fixture.title: Stable duplicate removal
fixture.description: Repair unique(values) so deduplication preserves first occurrence order and caller-owned input. None must raise TypeError.

requirements.text: Return each distinct value once in first-occurrence order, using Python equality.
Do not mutate the input list.

fixture.provenance: Original PatchProof synthetic fixture, authored 2026-09-27; no third-party code or data.

patch.diff.content:
diff --git a/solution.py b/solution.py
--- a/solution.py
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@
-def unique(values):
-    if values is None:
-        return []
-    values.sort()
-    return list(set(values))
+def unique(values):
+    if values is None:
+        raise TypeError("values must not be None")
+    result = []
+    for value in values:
+        if value not in result:
+            result.append(value)
+    return result
